description: Sample and hold with track and hold and pass and hold modes, sampling every channel of a polyphonic cable on one trigger

params.text: S samples the input on each rising trigger edge and holds it; T follows the input while the trigger is high and holds when it falls; P follows while the trigger is low and holds while it is high

inputs.text: The signal that is sampled and held
Drives the sampling, counting anything crossing 2V as high; what the transitions do is set by MODE
Picks the hold mode by voltage and takes the MODE switch out of circuit: under 2V gives S, 2V to 4V gives T, 4V and over gives P

outputs.text: Carries the held value with its sign flipped

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
